mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT uniteType, type2, type3, type4, type5 FROM (SELECT concat(A.ITEM_CODE,'|') uniteType, A.ITEM_CODE type2, NULL type3, NULL type4, NULL type5 FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST A WHERE DICT_CODE = 'CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_TWO' UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN A.ITEM_CODE IS NULL THEN concat(A.LINKED_ITEM_CODE,'|') ELSE concat(concat(A.LINKED_ITEM_CODE,'|'), A.ITEM_CODE) END uniteType, A.LINKED_ITEM_CODE type2, A.ITEM_CODE type3, NULL type4, NULL type5 FROM (SELECT LINKED_DICT_CODE LINKED_DICT_CODE, TRIM(LINKED_ITEM_CODE) LINKED_ITEM_CODE, DICT_CODE, ITEM_CODE FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST_LINK A WHERE A.LINKED_DICT_CODE = 'CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_TWO' ) A UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN A.ITEM_CODE IS NULL THEN concat(A.LINKED_ITEM_CODE ,'|') WHEN B.ITEM_CODE IS NULL THEN concatconcat(A.LINKED_ITEM_CODE ,'|'), A.ITEM_CODE) ELSE concat(concat(concat(concat(A.LINKED_ITEM_CODE,'|'), A.ITEM_CODE),'|') , B.ITEM_CODE) END uniteType, A.LINKED_ITEM_CODE type2, A.ITEM_CODE type3, B.ITEM_CODE type4, NULL type5 FROM (SELECT LINKED_DICT_CODE LINKED_DICT_CODE, TRIM(LINKED_ITEM_CODE) LINKED_ITEM_CODE, DICT_CODE, ITEM_CODE FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST_LINK A WHERE A.LINKED_DICT_CODE = 'CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_TWO' ) A LEFT JOIN (SELECT LINKED_DICT_CODE LINKED_DICT_CODE, TRIM(LINKED_ITEM_CODE) LINKED_ITEM_CODE, DICT_CODE, ITEM_CODE FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST_LINK A WHERE A.LINKED_DICT_CODE = 'CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_THREE' ) B ON A.DICT_CODE = B.LINKED_DICT_CODE AND A.ITEM_CODE = B.LINKED_ITEM_CODE UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN A.ITEM_CODE IS NULL THEN concat(A.LINKED_ITEM_CODE,'|') WHEN B.ITEM_CODE IS NULL THEN concat(concat(A.LINKED_ITEM_CODE ,'|'), A.ITEM_CODE) WHEN C.ITEM_CODE IS NULL THEN concat(concat(concat(concat(A.LINKED_ITEM_CODE ,'|') , A.ITEM_CODE),'|'), B.ITEM_CODE) ELSE concat(concat(concat(concat(concat(concat(A.LINKED_ITEM_CODE,'|'), A.ITEM_CODE),'|'), B.ITEM_CODE) ,'|'), C.ITEM_CODE) END uniteType, A.LINKED_ITEM_CODE type2, A.ITEM_CODE type3, B.ITEM_CODE type4, C.ITEM_CODE type5 FROM (SELECT LINKED_DICT_CODE LINKED_DICT_CODE, TRIM(LINKED_ITEM_CODE) LINKED_ITEM_CODE, DICT_CODE, ITEM_CODE FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST_LINK A WHERE A.LINKED_DICT_CODE = 'CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_TWO' ) A LEFT JOIN (SELECT LINKED_DICT_CODE LINKED_DICT_CODE, TRIM(LINKED_ITEM_CODE) LINKED_ITEM_CODE, DICT_CODE, ITEM_CODE FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST_LINK A WHERE A.LINKED_DICT_CODE = 'CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_THREE' ) B ON A.DICT_CODE = B.LINKED_DICT_CODE AND A.ITEM_CODE = B.LINKED_ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT LINKED_DICT_CODE, TRIM(LINKED_ITEM_CODE) LINKED_ITEM_CODE, DICT_CODE, ITEM_CODE FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST_LINK A WHERE A.LINKED_DICT_CODE = 'CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FOUR' ) C ON B.DICT_CODE = C.LINKED_DICT_CODE AND B.ITEM_CODE = C.LINKED_ITEM_CODE )
